select * from (select s.*, CASE WHEN exclusion_reason IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as included, (CASE WHEN exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN document_family='credit' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*ROUND(amount*100) as gross, (CASE WHEN exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN document_family='credit' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*ROUND(vatable_sales*100) as vatable, (CASE WHEN exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN document_family='credit' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*ROUND(vat_amount*100) as vat, (CASE WHEN exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN document_family='credit' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*ROUND(zero_rated_sales*100) as zero, (CASE WHEN exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN document_family='credit' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*ROUND(net_amount*100) as net, (CASE WHEN exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN document_family='credit' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*ROUND(statutory_discount_amount*100) as statutory_discount, (CASE WHEN exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN document_family='credit' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*ROUND(vat_relief_amount*100) as vat_adjustment, (CASE WHEN exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN document_family='credit' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*ROUND(manual_discount_amount*100) as manual_discount, (CASE WHEN exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN document_family='credit' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*ROUND(discount_amount*100) as discount, (CASE WHEN exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN document_family='credit' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*non_vat_centavos as non_vat, (CASE WHEN exclusion_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN document_family='credit' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END)*(ROUND(vat_exempt_sales*100)-non_vat_centavos+ROUND(sspt_sales*100)) as exempt from (select d.*, COALESCE(c.type,'unclassified') as customer_type, CASE
            WHEN d.document_family NOT IN ('invoice','credit','debit') THEN 'Payment / supplementary document: no additional invoice sales'
            WHEN d.status<>'success' THEN 'Not an active issued document'
            WHEN d.identity_count<>1 THEN 'Duplicate document identity needs source review'
            WHEN d.document_family IN ('credit','debit') AND (original.projection_id IS NULL OR original.status<>'success' OR original.document_family<>'invoice' OR original.tenant_identity_count<>1 OR original.financial_valid=0) THEN 'Adjustment requires a reconciled, active original invoice in this business'
            WHEN d.financial_valid=0 THEN 'Original line amounts / tax allocation do not reconcile'
            ELSE NULL END as exclusion_reason, 'not_verified' as bir_status from (select `projection_id`, `id`, `document_id`, `transaction_id`, `merchant_id`, `receipt_id`, `original_invoice_id`, `document_source`, `document_family`, `category`, `status`, `sale_category`, `transaction_ref`, `receipt_number`, `business`, `tin`, `branch_code`, `rdo_code`, `document_type`, `record_status`, `transaction_status`, `payment_method`, `region`, `branch`, `channel`, `customer_name`, `customer_tin`, `tin_digits`, `seller_tin_key`, `seller_branch_key`, `document_number_key`, `seller_address`, `amount`, `statutory_discount_amount`, `vat_relief_amount`, `discount_amount`, `manual_discount_amount`, `vat_amount`, `vatable_sales`, `vat_exempt_sales`, `zero_rated_sales`, `sspt_sales`, `net_amount`, `payment_amount`, `payment_count`, `business_date`, `created_at`, `recorded_at`, `business_day`, `identity_key`, `tenant_identity_key`, `tenant_identity_count`, `tenant_identity_rank`, `rank_key`, `financial_valid`, `non_vat_centavos`, `verified_branch`, `projected_at`, `operations_sales_valid`, `reconciliation_prefix`, `reconciliation_suffix`, `is_draft`, tenant_identity_count as identity_count, tenant_identity_rank as identity_rank from `ledger_documents` where `record_status` <> ? and `merchant_id` = ? and `tenant_identity_rank` = ?) as `d` left join `ledger_documents` as `original` on `original`.`projection_id` = CONCAT('invoice:',d.original_invoice_id) and `original`.`merchant_id` = `d`.`merchant_id` and `d`.`document_family` in (?, ?) left join merchant_customer_documents as cd FORCE INDEX (customer_document_once) on `cd`.`merchant_id` = `d`.`merchant_id` and `cd`.`document_source` = `d`.`document_source` and `cd`.`document_id` = `d`.`document_id` left join `merchant_customers` as `c` on `c`.`id` = `cd`.`customer_id` and `c`.`merchant_id` = `d`.`merchant_id` where `d`.`document_source` in (?, ?) and `d`.`business_day` >= ? and `d`.`business_day` <= ?) as `s`) as `report` where `projection_id` in (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) order by `business_day` desc, `projection_id` desc
